Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

RealStudyBackend.placement exists and serves a typed PlacementPreview after digest checking. That is meaningful progress over the original protocol gap. It is not the requested native implementation because it delegates to PlacementPreviewAdapter, where studio-core parses positions and applies CorrectionLedger itself. The remaining acceptance is exact: move placement through eyes4s’s public CoordinateProvenance/import route, retain DroppedInitial and off-window policy, then measure the 11.5k-record sidecar JSON round trip before making the redraw-budget claim.

Evidence:
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/real/RealStudyBackend.scala:107
- studio/core/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/core/geometry/PlacementPreviewAdapter.scala:27

Disposition: Keep open.
